notes.title: Angelo and Deemon 2: Too Hell of a Quest at Ukrainian Games Festival 2025!
notes.content: [p]Great news, everyone! We're thrilled to announce that Angelo and Deemon 2: Too Hell of a Quest is part of the Ukrainian Games Festival 2025 on Steam! To celebrate, we're reactivating the demo for the duration of the festival. Join us from August 14-21. [/p][p][/p][p]As a small indie team, we’ve poured our hearts into crafting this quirky adventure, blending hand-drawn art with devilishly fun humor. The development process has been a wild ride—late-night coding sessions, endless coffee, and heated debates over whether Deemon’s snark is too snarky! Want to peek behind the curtain? Join our Discord to chat with us, share your demo feedback, and maybe even influence the final polish of Angelo’s heavenly quest. See you at the festival![/p]

notes.title: Next Fest Demo deactivation update.
notes.content: [p]Thanks, everyone, for playing the demo and sharing your valued feedback. [/p][p][/p][p]This is a quick note to let you know that the Angelo and Deemon 2: Too Hell of a Quest Next Fest demo will be deactivated on July 1st. [/p][p][/p][p]If you haven't played it yet, then please do so before that time. [/p][p][/p][p]We'll have a new demo closer to a release. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: The Demo is live!
notes.content: [p]Great news, everyone! The Steam Fest Demo for Angelo and Deemon 2 is live. [/p][p][/p][p]It's still WIP, and we expect some bugs. Our main goal is to gather your feedback. Please feel free to share any thoughts about the game. I can't promise that we will include all of your ideas, but who knows? You may influence the game at this point.[/p][p][/p][p]You may share your feedback here on our [url="https://discord.gg/DFMJUjE"]Discord server.[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you![/p]

notes.title: Angelo and Deemon 2: Too Hell of a Quest demo during Steam Next Fest!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone! We've been quiet for quite some time.[/p][p]We're thrilled to announce that Angelo and Deemon 2: Too Hell of a Quest will have a demo release during Steam Next Fest on June 9th![/p][p][/p][p]🕹️ Dive back into the world you love with new challenges and surprises. Be among the first to experience this![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45154929/e1a161a3f7d711c8e066a0c696b3288cb068147d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The demo is still a work in progress, and we appreciate any feedback you share with us.[/p][p]This can be done in our [url="https://discord.gg/DFMJUjE"]Discord server[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Get ready for an adventure![/p]
